title: Flat-term K-flat preservation for the ordinary geometric realization
statement:
variable {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C]
  (B : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
  (τ : ∀ n : ℕ, B (n + 1) ⟶ B n)
  {C' : Type c} [Category.{v} C'] [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C']
  (J' : GrothendieckTopology C')
  (uInv : Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)))
  (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
  (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush)
  (O : GeometryOrdinary.{c, v, r} J B τ J' uInv uPush adjSet)


theorem geometricOrdinary_kflat [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv] :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (P : CochainComplex (Mod.{c, v, max c v r} J (B n)) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := B n) P →
      flatTerms.{c, v, r} J (B n) P →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J') (R := O.coefficients n)
        (((O.inverseImage n).modules.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ∧
    (∀ (P : CochainComplex (Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := coefficientSequenceTopology J)
        (R := systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) P →
      flatTerms.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J)
        (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) P →
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := coefficientSequenceTopology J')
        (R := systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J' O.coefficients O.coefficientTransition)
        ((O.pull.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))

proof.text: At each level apply the proved ringed-topos K-flat pullback theorem with identity scalar extension, then remove this extension using the proved scalar unit isomorphism.

Exact jointly faithful evaluations detect acyclicity. Extend the ordinary tensor evaluation isomorphism to tensor totals using the evaluation/coextension adjunction, hence preservation of coproducts. Evaluating any acyclic tensor test shows that levelwise K-flatness implies system K-flatness.

Evaluation preserves flat-term K-flat representatives. Evaluate the source system, apply the level pullback result, and transport through ordinaryPullEvaluation. The preceding detection lemma gives K-flatness of the pulled system.
